mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.wallet_activated_at AS activated_at, COALESCE(w.balance_cents,0) AS balance_cents FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN wallet_sandbox_account w ON w.user_id=u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET wallet_activated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND account_status = 1 AND wallet_activated_at IS NULL
mapper.sql:
o.order_no, o.status, o.amount_cents, o.currency, o.gmt_create AS created_at, o.paid_at, o.closed_at,
credited_at, NULL AS consultation_id, NULL AS report_id, NULL AS doctor_user_id, NULL AS settlement_status NULL AS credited_at, consultation_id, report_id, doctor_user_id, settlement_status
, CASE WHEN o.status = 'PAID' THEN ( SELECT e.balance_after_cents FROM wallet_sandbox_ledgerconsultation_wallet_entry e WHERE e.order_no = o.order_no AND e.user_id = o.user_id ) ELSE NULL END AS balance_after_cents
mapper.select: SELECT FROM o WHERE ORDER BY o.gmt_create DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
